decisions.decision: The Board took no action on joining the Central Mass Regional Stormwater Coalition and will review the agreement again at the May 17 meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Department of Energy Resource grant awarded funds to bring on a solar technical advisor.
budget_items.quote: the grant awarded $12,500 to bring on an advisor.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Solect Energy proposed a 20-year fixed-rate contract for the middle/high school and the DPW garage.
budget_items.quote: it would be a 20 year contract for the middle/high school at 8.3 cents/kw hour and 13.5 cents/kw hour for the dpw, both at fixed rates.

budget_items.topic: Solar lease payment and annual savings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A monthly lease payment applies to the middle/high school and annual savings were projected for both buildings.
budget_items.quote: annual savings would be $62,080 for the middle/high school and $3,472 for the dpw garage.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The annual membership fee for the Central Mass Regional Stormwater Coalition is stated.
Town Manager reported existing stormwater funding for this year and fiscal 2017.
budget_items.quote: ms. lafleur reported there is $40,000 in the budget this year and $50,000 for fiscal 2017 for stormwater activities.

budget_items.topic: 319 Nonpoint Source grant for lake watershed
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The 319 grant offers up to a set amount and requires a cash and in-kind match.
budget_items.quote: the grant offers up to $600,000 but it requires a 40% match, half in cash, half in kind

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Adult education classes could cover bus fees.
budget_items.quote: this could cover the $30,000 for bus fees.

budget_items.topic: Lanni Orchards agricultural preservation restriction match
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town is expected to make a match for the proposed state acquisition, depending on factors.
budget_items.quote: she explained the town is expected to make a match of 5% or 10% depending on certain factors.

budget_items.topic: Accounts Payable warrant and water commitment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an Accounts Payable warrant and a water commitment.
budget_items.quote: the board signed the 4* quarter water commitment of fy 2016 in the amount of $8,791.20.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public pancake breakfast price per person was announced (not a town expense).
budget_items.quote: the price is $2 per person for pancakes, sausage, tater crowns, fruit, pastry, juice and coffee.
